task: Final review of remaining components with a bounded economic hypothesis set
knowledge: All historical inputs and prior experiments have been seen. These are conditional diagnostics, not fresh OOS evidence.
main_policy: Keep original monthly basket and 63-day history; current six ETFs and macro rules unchanged

hypotheses.inverse_vol: Remove correlation estimation from weights; exactly equivalent to two-asset long-only ERC, changes only three-asset baskets. No tuned shrinkage coefficient.
hypotheses.equal: Remove risk forecasting and allocate equal capital within selected basket. Exposes the return-versus-risk tradeoff, not presumed improvement.
hypotheses.same_day_cash: ETF sale proceeds are generally usable the same day. Match broker actual available cash after fills; quote model with extra buy-side friction tests sensitivity. Not a prediction of free extra alpha.
hypotheses.input_governance: Audit missing versus unchanged versus expired versus redefined policy indicators, historical collector boundaries and unmatched macro state persistence. A source-validity correction is not a return optimization.

decision: Keep ERC unless a coherent improvement transfers across starts, non-overlapping periods and asset-history controls without a disproportionate increase in volatility or drawdown. Keep failures; do not optimize a mixing coefficient after seeing results. Execution choices follow actual funds availability, not the more profitable historical convention.
unchanged_by_design: No new asset selection, leverage, trend overlay, stop loss, macro threshold, policy weight or calendar optimization. The current user asks whether such changes are necessary, not permission to deploy them.
